avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left Surprise Lakes (4,280 ft) and Spencer Meadow (3,400 ft) 21 to 31 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Surprise Lakes
evidence.detail: left May 19; earlier seasons: June 19 (2023), June 20 (2024), June 12 (2025)

evidence.name: Spencer Meadow
evidence.detail: left April 24; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 14 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Surprise Lakes (4,280 ft) and Spencer Meadow (3,400 ft).

evidence.name: Surprise Lakes
evidence.detail: 23.5 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 58.2 in (2023), 39.2 in (2024), 50.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Spencer Meadow
evidence.detail: 8.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 39.1 in (2023), 21.4 in (2024), 25.9 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 26 and May 20, carried from the melt-out dates at Surprise Lakes (4,280 ft) and Spencer Meadow (3,400 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Surprise Lakes
evidence.detail: melted out May 19, 1,219 ft above the pass; points to March 28 to May 28

evidence.name: Spencer Meadow
evidence.detail: melted out April 24, 339 ft above the pass; points to March 25 to May 12
